title: Deliver Diamonds to Dardinghead Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Diamonds** delivered to **Dardinghead Bank** (industry id 4, near tile 45,105).

A likely supplier is **Flondingbury Diamond Mine** (industry id 5, near tile 39,73); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **2,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
